newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX index falls, MOL rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX index falls, MOL rebounds.

text.p: Hungarian share prices remained in mostly narrow ranges on Tuesday as the strong dollar failed failed to give a boost while foreign markets could not show a strong direction, traders said.
"The dollar is strong but it did not help," said Laszlo Baranyai of Gog Securities.
The BUX index finished at 5,487.45 points, down 109.51.
Corporate results had mixed impact on share prices, traders said.

Pharmaceuticals Richter dipped five forints to end at 11,895 forints after the release of 1996 figures but traders said its price fall stemmed from a general market sentiment and not from the results.
"The price fall has nothing to do with the results, it reflects a general market sentiment," one trader said earlier.
Garment maker Styl hit a new high of 1,825 forints after the release of its 1996 results but traders said that less liquid stocks like Styl can sharply move in only a few deals.
"It was not evident that Styl rose because of the results," one trader said today.
Elsewhere on the market chemicals stocks ended mixed, with Borsodchem dipping 25 forints to 6,100, while TVK advancing 45 forints to 2,450.
Bank stocks were also mixed, with Inter-Europa Bank IEKB.BU edging 50 forints up to 50,000 and OTP falling 100 forints to 3,600.
All shares in the beverage sector closed lower.
